dc:title: NIM lex - flavor vocabulary
dc:description: Word lists, phrases, and templates for NIM naming and lore (persona layer D, plan.101426.persona.md). Each table is described here after W3C CSV on the Web (CSVW) metadata; lib/data/lex.py reads and checks the files against it. dc:type is the unit of a row: word (one term; eligible for salad), phrase (multi-word term), sentence, template (with {placeholders}), or record (several columns). Several tables share a name with a model table but are a different sense - see each dc:description.
